mentions.name: Knotend
mentions.description: A grid-based flowchart editor designed for speed, optimized for keyboard use with a spreadsheet-like selection and movement mechanism for creating diagrams such as project dependency graphs.
mentions.problem: The author was tired of dragging boxes and arrows around in Miro while making dependency graphs for planning projects.
mentions.source_excerpt: A grid-based flowchart editor designed for speed. It’s optimized for the keyboard with a spreadsheet-like selection and movement mechanism.
